labels.what: two descriptive follow-ups to G-DIAG (FD-G-FOLLOWUP-DECLARATION.md); numbers only, no new statistic
labels.r04: numbers from the pinned products for R04 and the cells that load with it in G-DIAG's top modes
labels.sens: descriptive sensitivity of the reported χ², not an alternative result: one family of S1 groups has its correlations shrunk toward the diagonal, C(alpha) = D^1/2 [(1 - alpha) rho + alpha I] D^1/2, its variances kept; no p-value
labels.units: relative to f: d = (f - g)/f, M = (C + V_g)/(f f^T), so sqrt(lambda) is a relative sigma (the G-DIAG ruling); chi2 and ndf are unit-free
labels.not: no reading, claim or paper text

item3_correlation_with_R04.note: a block of rank 1 (each C_model vertex; normalization) has correlations of +-1 by construction; a block with zero variance at a cell (seed, if zero) has none (null)

nuwro.label: NuWro 21.09; C12 target; no correction to CH applied

gibuu.label: GiBUU 2019; C12 target; no correction to CH applied; no events above E_nu = 20 GeV (KNOWN_ISSUES 82), so it is compared on the eight p_parallel < 4.5 cells only and not shown above p_parallel 4.5 (FD-DIRECTOR-RULINGS.md section 5)

R04.why: not one of this prediction's cells in Stage G

R07.why: not one of this prediction's cells in Stage G

R14.why: not one of this prediction's cells in Stage G

mnvtune_v1.label: MINERvA Tune v1, the analysis MC truth: prior (not an independent prediction)

item5_search.matched_on: the last key of each key path
item5_search.note: keys only: a match is a key whose name contains a searched word; it is not a count unless its value is one, and only the definition's per-cell values are reported

s5p_manifest_paths_matching.note: file names listed in the pinned manifest; not opened

sens.mode_index: a top mode's index is its place in that matrix's own eigen-order (lambda descending); it does not name the same mode across alpha
